searchText: I'm conflicted on this because I do think there is value in closing out the non-discussion issues, discussion issues for EIPs that are stagnant, and discussion issues for EIPs that are final. But I do agree that it is annoying when the bot offers to close an active discussion issue. Maybe labels would help here? Or a well defined naming convention? As a quick solution perhaps we could have a github label `discussion url` and let the bot ignore those from closing. Here you go: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/4436
